replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
There might be too much diamonds considering the size of the map is pretty small... There doesn't seem to be enough space for PvP to take place on.
I suggest expanding the map a bit and distance the monuments a bit from eachother, also removing some diamond blocks might be good as well!
